scenes.title_cn: 团建日：咖啡厅远程办公
scenes.title_en: Team Day: Remote Working at a Café
scenes.context: 今天公司举办团建活动，博主没去办公室，在活动附近的咖啡厅远程办公，早上的会议很多。语域：日常口播，记录早晨。
sentences: 今天公司举办了一个小小的团建活动，所以今天早上我就没有去office。
My company had a small team-building event today, so I didn't go to the office this morning.
team-building event（团建活动）；go to the office（去办公室）
直接在这个活动附近的咖啡厅小小工作了一下。
I just did a bit of work at a café near the event instead.
a bit of work（小小工作一下）；near the event（活动附近）
早上的会议还是蛮多的，现在把会议都开完了。
There were quite a few meetings this morning, and now they're all done.
quite a few（蛮多的）；meetings（会议）
paraphrase: 团建活动 → team-building event / a company get-together
team-building · get-together
开完会议 → wrap up the meetings / get through the meetings
wrap up · get through
scenes.speak: My company had a small team-building event today, so I didn't go to the office this morning. I just did a bit of work at a café near the event instead. There were quite a few meetings this morning, and now they're all done.

scenes.title_en: Heading to the Toronto Humane Society
scenes.context: 团建活动在 Distillery 附近，叫 Toronto Humane Society，类似动物救助站，也提供绝育等宠物服务。风很大，每次录影就开始刮风。语域：介绍口播，边走边说。
sentences: 活动其实是在Distillery附近，是叫做Toronto Humane Society。
The event is near the Distillery District, at a place called the Toronto Humane Society.
the Toronto Humane Society（多伦多人道协会）
如果直译过来的话，可能类似一个动物的救助站之类的。
Translated literally, it's something like an animal rescue shelter.
translated literally（直译过来）；an animal rescue shelter（动物救助站）
它其实也有一些其他的宠物服务，比如说绝育啊，它们也是可以做的。
It also offers other pet services — like spaying and neutering.
pet services（宠物服务）；spaying and neutering（绝育）
paraphrase: 动物救助站 → an animal rescue shelter / a humane society
rescue shelter · humane society
直译过来 → translated literally / taken literally
translated literally · literally
scenes.speak: The event is near the Distillery District, at a place called the Toronto Humane Society. Translated literally, it's something like an animal rescue shelter. It also offers other pet services — like spaying and neutering.

scenes.title_cn: 收容所猫猫：可爱名场面
scenes.context: 在收容所里看到很多猫，博主被可爱到不断感叹，还发现一只猫把眼睛贴在旁边。可以带孩子和其他猫一起来。语域：现场感叹，萌物治愈。
sentences: 你可以带你的孩子、你的其他猫。
You can bring your kids and your other cats.
bring your kids（带孩子）
我的天啊，那是肥猫，你为什么要把眼睛放在旁边？
Oh my god, that cat is so chubby — why is its eye pressed against the glass?
chubby（胖乎乎的）；pressed against the glass（贴在玻璃上）
好可爱，我喜欢你的耳朵。
So cute — I love your ears.
so cute（好可爱）；I love your ...（我喜欢你的…）
paraphrase: 胖乎乎的猫 → a chubby cat / a fluffy cat
chubby · fluffy
贴在玻璃上 → pressed against the glass / leaning on the glass
pressed against · leaning on
scenes.speak: You can bring your kids and your other cats. Oh my god, that cat is so chubby — why is its eye pressed against the glass? So cute — I love your ears.

scenes.title_en: 128 Vietnamese Noodles: A Hidden Gem in the North
scenes.context: 博主之前保养车时来试过这家越南粉，觉得很好吃，今天特意推荐给大家。语域：美食推荐口播。
sentences: 今天早上我们起了个大早，就去出门办一点事情。
We got up early this morning and went out to run some errands.
get up early（起个大早）；run errands（办事）
之前因为来这边保养车的时候，来试过这一家越南粉，我觉得很好吃。
I tried this pho place when I came to service my car, and I thought it was really good.
service my car（保养车）；pho place（越南粉店）
就是这家128，我觉得还蛮不错的。
It's this place, 128 — I'd say it's pretty solid.
pretty solid（还蛮不错的）
paraphrase: 办事 → run errands / take care of some things
run errands · take care of things
宝藏店 → a hidden gem / a great find
hidden gem · great find
scenes.speak: We got up early this morning and went out to run some errands. I tried this pho place when I came to service my car, and I thought it was really good. It's this place, 128 — I'd say it's pretty solid.

scenes.title_cn: 真米粉口感，肉超级好吃
scenes.context: 尝了一口发现里面是米粉不是面条，口感真实不塑料，肉超级好吃，越吃越好吃。语域：美食试吃，惊喜语气。
sentences: 我没有想到里面是粉，超级好吃这个粉。
I didn't expect it to be rice noodles — this noodle is super tasty.
rice noodles（米粉）；super tasty（超级好吃）
不像是那种塑料的，它真的有米粉的感觉、米线的感觉。
It's not that plasticky kind — it really has that genuine rice-noodle feel.
plasticky（像塑料的）；a genuine feel（真实的口感）
这个越吃是越好吃了。
The more I eat, the tastier it gets.
the more ..., the ...（越…越…）
paraphrase: 真实口感 → a genuine texture / an authentic feel
genuine · authentic
越吃越好吃 → the more I eat, the tastier it gets / it grows on you
the more the tastier · grows on you
scenes.speak: I didn't expect it to be rice noodles — this noodle is super tasty. It's not that plasticky kind — it really has that genuine rice-noodle feel. The more I eat, the tastier it gets.

scenes.title_cn: 开发商+咖啡厅合体空间
scenes.context: 这家咖啡厅很特别：左边是开发商公司，右边有个小角落可以喝咖啡办公，电脑支架都贴心提供。博主觉得有这种设施的咖啡厅更愿意来工作。语域：探店口播，惊喜发现。
sentences: 这个咖啡厅非常特别，左边这边是一个开发商。
This café is really special — the left side is a developer's office.
a developer's office（开发商办公室）
有一个小角落，可以给这边的人喝咖啡办办公。
There's a little corner where people can grab coffee and work.
grab coffee（喝咖啡）；work（办公）
电脑的这些支架都是这边提供的。
Even the laptop stands are provided right here.
laptop stands（电脑支架）；be provided（由…提供）
paraphrase: 贴心地提供 → thoughtfully provided / a nice touch
thoughtfully · a nice touch
合体空间 → a combined space / a hybrid space
combined · hybrid
scenes.speak: This café is really special — the left side is a developer's office. There's a little corner where people can grab coffee and work. Even the laptop stands are provided right here.

scenes.context: 已经8点20了天气还是很好、还没有天黑，出来走走遛遛狗。云很好看，夕阳更好看。男友看到陌生人在玩飞盘问 Can I join，就跑去玩了。语域：傍晚散步，轻松惬意。
sentences: 现在已经8点20了，但是天气还是很好，而且还没有天黑。
It's already 8:20, but the weather is still great and it hasn't gotten dark yet.
it hasn't gotten dark（还没天黑）
这个云还蛮好看的，这边的夕阳更好看一点。
The clouds are pretty — and the sunset over here is even nicer.
the sunset（夕阳）；even nicer（更好看一点）
男友突然看到他们三个在玩，问他们说Can I join，然后就去玩了。
My boyfriend saw those three playing and asked, 'Can I join?' — then went off to play.
Can I join?（我能加入吗）
paraphrase: 金色夕阳 → a golden sunset / the sun setting in gold
golden sunset · setting in gold
遛狗 → walk the dog / take the dog out
walk the dog · take the dog out
scenes.speak: It's already 8:20, but the weather is still great and it hasn't gotten dark yet. The clouds are pretty — and the sunset over here is even nicer. My boyfriend saw those three playing and asked, 'Can I join?' — then went off to play.

scenes.title_cn: 和小狗散步，傲娇十岁老狗
scenes.context: 男友去玩飞盘了，剩下博主和小狗继续散步。十岁的老狗依然很有想法、很傲娇。最后夕阳下遛狗，天色渐暗，宝贝回家。语域：温馨日常，软萌收尾。
sentences: 因为男友现在跑去跟陌生男人们玩飞盘了，所以就是剩下我跟小狗来这附近走一走。
Since my boyfriend ran off to play frisbee with strangers, it's just me and the dog wandering around here.
play frisbee（玩飞盘）；wandering around（走一走）
那场傲娇的拆卷，怎么十岁了还这么有想法？
That proud, grumpy look — how can you be ten years old and still so full of opinions?
grumpy（傲娇、闹脾气）；full of opinions（很有想法）
宝贝回家吧。
Come on, baby, let's go home.
come on, baby（宝贝）
paraphrase: 傲娇 → proud and grumpy / aloof and sassy
grumpy · aloof · sassy
很有想法 → full of opinions / knows what it wants
full of opinions · knows what it wants
scenes.speak: Since my boyfriend ran off to play frisbee with strangers, it's just me and the dog wandering around here. That proud, grumpy look — how can you be ten years old and still so full of opinions? Come on, baby, let's go home.

practice: 介绍你的公司团建活动
My company had a small team-building event today, so I worked from a café nearby.
There's a pho place near the garage — the noodles are super tasty and the meat is amazing.
The clouds are pretty, but the sunset over here is even nicer.
My dog is ten years old, but he's still so proud and full of opinions.
pitfalls: The event is near the Distillery District.
句子缺谓语动词 be；near 是介词，不能单独作谓语。
It has a animal rescue station.
It's something like an animal rescue shelter.
shelter（收容所）比 station 更准确；something like 表达「类似」的语气也更自然。
The noodle is super good eat.
The rice noodles are super tasty.
tasty（好吃）是形容词，不能说 good eat；米粉用复数 rice noodles。
I more like to work here.
I'd be more willing to come work here.
be willing to（愿意做某事）表达倾向；I more like 是中式直译，不地道。
shifts: 用 super tasty、amazing、pretty solid、越吃越好吃 the more the tastier
用 nice、pretty、golden（金色的）、even nicer 表达程度对比
用 walk the dog（遛狗）、wander around（散步）、hang out（待在一起）
footer_notes: ASR 专有名词已校正：Monter→团建、Destillery→Distillery、Van→车行、128→128越南粉、拆卷→吃卷/表情、灯绿→耽误、赌咖啡→咖啡等。
